objective: Adopt the approved standalone default App Runtime declaration in its real consumers before the first Tencent/TKE launch: Runtime Control admits it, custom Agent Build keeps its recipe/format refusals, and Workspace refuses a model update before any effect when the frozen release declares no publisher model-configuration interface.

runtimeControl: services/runtime-control/migrations/0002_standalone_runtime_declaration.sql turns the storage guard into 'an absent Package-format declaration equals the empty list' and keeps exact equality once formats are declared.

services/runtime-control/catalog/service.go stores the empty list instead of NULL when a release declares no Package format, so the column stays non-null and the contract bytes stay exactly as declared.

services/runtime-control/catalog/runtime_release_postgres_test.go admits a standalone declaration read back byte-faithfully, refuses an incomplete declared model interface and keeps the existing unadmitted-publisher/contract refusals.
workspace: services/workspace/internal/launch/models_update.go resolves the frozen Runtime Release (default App directly; built Agent through its admitted CapabilityVersion) and refuses a model update before any owner effect when that release declares no model-configuration interface.

services/workspace/internal/launch/application_source.go splits the approved-release read so the launch path keeps its immutable-application-contract requirement while the model-update path adds no new one.

services/workspace/internal/launch/models_update_test.go seeds both launch shapes and proves the refusal leaves gateway/fabric/serve untouched, the applied version at 0 and no update operation recorded, while the same launch with a declared interface still applies.
customAgentBuildBoundary: services/capability/catalog/gap6_closure_test.go (commit d5a36c74) pins that a Runtime declaration missing buildRecipe (DataLoss) or packageFormatVersions (FailedPrecondition) is still refused by the real Build combination consumer.
